name: 吉备津神社本殿及拜殿
checkpoints: Keep BOTH connected historic structures: large left honden with characteristic TWO adjacent hip-and-gable gables, and smaller projecting right haiden.
Honden has twin hiyoku irimoya bark roofs; haiden has steep bark gabled main roof and low surrounding tiled mokoshi eave. Their roof types must stay different.

Photographed aged reddish-brown timber, white gable infill, verandas, haiden columns and front stairs. Remove modern fences, lamps and signs; preserve oblique composition, NOT a symmetrical invented frontage.
